title: The iterated geometric Green's formula
summary: Fang, Lan, and Xiao established the geometric Green's formula as a categorical isomorphism for arbitrary semisimple complexes. In this short note, we generalize their work to multi-step compositions. Specifically, we establish the iterated geometric Green's formulas for the composition of an $(n-1)$-fold restriction and an induction, as well as its dual.
